description: OhmGraphite takes the hard work of extracting hardware sensors from Open Hardware Monitor and exports the data in a graphite (or InfluxdDB / Prometheus / TimescaleDB) compatible format.
pre_uninstall: if ((Get-Service OhmGraphite).Status -eq 'Running') { Set-Content -Path $runStateFile -Value '1' -Encoding ASCII; Write-Host 'Service was running; will restart after upgrade.' -ForegroundColor Yellow } elseif (Test-Path $runStateFile) { Remove-Item $runStateFile -Force }
post_install: if (Test-Path $runStateFile) { Start-Process -Wait "$dir\OhmGraphite.exe" 'start'; Remove-Item $runStateFile -Force; Write-Host 'Service restarted (was running before upgrade).' -ForegroundColor Yellow }
